name: OpenTime
summary: OpenTime is an Expert Advisor that trades at specific session open times, entering positions when a new trading session begins. It captures the momentum and volatility that typically occurs at market open by placing trades in the direction of the prevailing trend or based on predefined directional bias at session start. The EA uses time-based entry logic combined with session-specific price action to execute trades.
summary_zh: OpenTime是一个在特定交易时段开盘时进行交易的Expert Advisor,在新的交易时段开始时进场持仓。它通过在市场开盘时沿当前趋势方向或预设方向下单来捕捉通常在开盘时出现的动量和波动性。该EA使用基于时间的入场逻辑结合时段特定的价格行为来执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于交易时段开盘时刻的波动性捕捉,认为市场在主要时段(如伦敦、纽约)开盘时往往会出现方向性突破和较大波动。入场条件为当服务器时间到达预设的交易时段开盘时间时,EA会根据当前价格与前一周期收盘价的关系或趋势指标判断方向并开仓。出场条件通常包括止盈和止损的设置,也可能在时段结束时平仓以避免隔夜风险。仓位管理方面,EA允许用户固定手数或根据账户余额动态计算仓位大小。资金管理依赖于止损距离与账户风险的比值,但具体实现细节因源码为二进制无法完全确认。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on capturing volatility at trading session open times, under the assumption that major sessions (London, New York) often produce directional breakouts and significant moves at their open. Entry conditions trigger when server time reaches a predefined session open time, where the EA determines trade direction based on the relationship between current price and previous period close or trend indicators. Exit conditions typically include take profit and stop loss levels, and may also close positions at session end to avoid overnight risk. Position sizing allows the user to set fixed lots or dynamically calculate size based on account balance. Money management relies on the ratio of stop loss distance to account risk, though specific implementation details cannot be fully confirmed as the source code is binary and unreadable.

parameters.description_en: EA magic number to identify its own orders

pros: 时段开盘交易逻辑合理,利用市场开盘波动性提高胜率
时间驱动的入场机制简单明确,易于理解和优化
通过限制交易时段可以有效控制风险暴露时间
支持自定义开盘和收盘时间,灵活适应不同市场时段
pros_en: Session open trading logic is sound, leveraging market open volatility for higher win rate
Time-driven entry mechanism is simple and clear, easy to understand and optimize
Risk exposure time is effectively controlled by limiting trading to specific sessions
Customizable open and close times provide flexibility for different market sessions
cons: 仅依赖时间触发入场,缺乏趋势确认和多重过滤可能导致频繁假突破
时段开盘波动可能双向扫损,止损容易被触发后价格再沿原方向运行
未观察到新K线检查机制,同一时段可能重复开仓
缺乏点差过滤,在流动性较低的时段开盘时点差可能较大导致不利入场
cons_en: Relies solely on time-triggered entry without trend confirmation or multiple filters, potentially causing frequent false breakouts
Session open volatility can whipsaw, triggering stop loss before price moves in the intended direction
No new bar check observed, which may lead to duplicate position opening within the same session
Lacks spread filter, wide spreads at low-liquidity session opens can result in unfavorable entries
improvements: 增加趋势确认指标(如EMA、RSI)作为入场过滤条件,避免逆势交易
添加新K线检查和持仓检查机制,防止同一时段重复开仓
加入点差过滤和波动率过滤,在极端条件下暂停交易
improvements_en: Add trend confirmation indicators (e.g., EMA, RSI) as entry filters to avoid counter-trend trades
Implement new bar check and position check mechanisms to prevent duplicate opening within the same session
Add spread filter and volatility filter to pause trading under extreme conditions

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一时段重复开仓,增加仓位风险
时段开盘波动性大,止损可能被短暂扫损后价格回归
未观察到点差过滤,低流动性时段开盘点差扩大可能造成滑点损失
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar check may lead to duplicate position opening within the same session, increasing position risk
Session open volatility is high, stop loss may be triggered by temporary whipsaw before price returns to direction
No spread filter observed, wider spreads at low-liquidity session opens can cause slippage losses
